units.text: INT. FEDERAL COURTROOM 11 - DAY
Oak paneling.
A seal on the wall.
A jury box with twelve empty chairs.
It is a pretrial conference, and the room has the hush of a library.
JUDGE ROSALIND ABERNATHY-KOMOLAFE (60s, robe, reading glasses) presides.
At the plaintiff's table: COUNSEL BENEDICT ASANTE-FAIRWEATHER (50s, three-piece suit) and his associate, MS. PRISCILLA DUARTE-LINDQVIST (20s, legal pad, nervous knee).
At the defense table: ATTORNEY MARCUS OYELOWO-STRAND (40s, rolled sleeves) and his co-counsel, A WOMAN IN A NAVY SUIT (30s), who has not been introduced.
The court reporter, DELPHINA MWANGI-HOLCOMB (50s), types without looking up.
Counsel, the pretrial order states discovery closed March first.
units.name: JUDGE ROSALIND

units.text: It did, Your Honor.
units.name: BENEDICT

units.text: It did not.
units.name: MARCUS

units.text: Mr. Oyelowo-Strand?
units.name: JUDGE ROSALIND

units.text: Your Honor, the plaintiff's production of the August emails came forty days late.
units.name: MARCUS

units.text: Because your client's servers were corrupted.
units.name: BENEDICT

units.text: Because your client's counsel was unreachable.
units.name: MARCUS

units.text: That's not what the file says.
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: I know.
units.name: BENEDICT

units.text: Counsel, address the court, not each other.
units.name: JUDGE ROSALIND

units.text: Yes, Your Honor.
units.name: BENEDICT

units.text: The woman in the navy suit leans toward Marcus and passes a folded note.
He reads it.
His jaw tightens.
Your Honor, with the court's permission, may I introduce my co-counsel?
units.name: MARCUS

units.text: Please.
units.name: JUDGE ROSALIND

units.text: Jocasta Reyes-Abiola, Your Honor. Appearing for the defense.
units.name: THE WOMAN

units.text: We have a motion.
units.name: JOCASTA

units.text: Priscilla stops writing.
Benedict removes his glasses.
Delphina's fingers pause over the keys.
Ms. Reyes-Abiola, proceed.
units.name: JUDGE ROSALIND

units.text: We move to compel the original server logs from August fourteenth.
units.name: JOCASTA

units.text: Your Honor, those logs do not exist.
units.name: BENEDICT

units.text: Then Mr. Asante-Fairweather can explain to the court why his firm billed us for reviewing them.
units.name: JOCASTA

units.text: Silence.
Priscilla, very softly, to no one:
Oh no.
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: Benedict sets down his pen and does not look at her.
Mr. Asante-Fairweather, would you care to respond?
units.name: JUDGE ROSALIND

units.text: I would like a recess, Your Honor.
units.name: BENEDICT

units.text: Denied. Respond.
units.name: JUDGE ROSALIND
